text:
nora (Billing): Heads-up — TheraNova payment for INV-4723 ($82,500) just failed at checkout. Stripe returned `do_not_honor`. Customer emailed saying they need to settle today. Can we surface alternatives and next steps?

maya (Finance): Quick check: Stripe shows charge.failed with `card_declined` + `issuer_declined`. No 3DS challenge, no CVC decline. Could be BIN block or high-value flag on issuer side.

liam (Sales Ops): Customer rep says treasury can do wire or ACH today. They asked for our bank details + remittance memo. I'll confirm which they prefer and get their payment ETA.

stripe-bot: PaymentIntent pi_4Lm2... status: requires_payment_method -> charge.failed (card_declined). Customer email: payments@theranova.health.

nora (Billing): Please don't send wire instructions until Finance signs off. Draft wire (hold for approval):
```
Bank: Glacia Bank NA
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account number: 987654321
Routing / SWIFT: GLACUS44XXX
Reference: TheraNova INV-4723
```

maya (Finance): Approve sending wire details to customer ops once Liam confirms they're initiating today. Request: ask for originating bank name, sender account last 4, and a remittance screenshot after transfer so Carl can auto-apply. If they do ACH (US origination) we can same-day apply once ACH settles.

liam (Sales Ops): On it. I'll ping them now and ask: 1) wire vs ACH, 2) desired send date/time, 3) billing@redwood.ai cc on payment email, 4) include invoice reference in remittance.

carl (Finance Ops): FYI — if wire, we need an email with the SWIFT trace or MT103 to reconcile. If ACH, ask them to include the ACH trace ID. I'll monitor bank and Stripe webhooks. If they prefer retry on card, we allow a single manual retry after 12 hours (per risk policy) and will escalate to risk if it fails again. :mag:

nora (Billing): Plan of record: 1) Liam confirms method + ETA and pastes their payment confirmation here. 2) Maya approves wire template (or confirms we can accept ACH). 3) Carl reconcilies once funds visible. 4) If no response by EOD PT, schedule 1 manual card retry at +12h and follow up with collections.

maya (Finance): Sounds good. Also flag to sales: ask them to confirm billing entity (TheraNova US vs EU) — if EU entity sends a non-US card/wire, we may need different bank details and VAT handling.

liam (Sales Ops): Quick update — they can ACH from US bank. Treasury asked for net-amount settlement (no fees) and will initiate today at 17:30 ET. I told them to cc billing@redwood.ai and attach the remittance screenshot.

carl (Finance Ops): Thanks — once they send remittance, I'll watch for ACH trace and post same day. Marking invoice as `payment_pending` and placing collection notices on hold until funds clear.

nora (Billing): Awesome. If ACH lands, I'll mark invoice paid and close. If we don't receive the remittance by EOD ET, Liam will push for wire or we attempt a single manual card retry at +12h as fallback.

liam (Sales Ops): I'll follow up after 17:30 with confirmation from their treasury.

maya (Finance): One more: please save their payment confirmation email in Zendesk ticket #12345 and add a note of the expected net amount (no fees) so accounting posts correctly.

nora (Billing): Copy. Leaving thread open until cleared. :white_check_mark:
